title: Back into the Swing.
author: Kane Baker
desc:
First two weeks ignore the RPE (Rate of Perceived  Effort) and go through the motions and getting used to the exercise patterns and motions.
Then a 12 week program working hard on each and every set with a focus on slow controlled movemens and good form. Pushing to near failure on every set. 
Having adequate rest between sets in order to push hard again on the next set. 
Failure before 8 reps = decrease weight
Completion of all 12 on each set = increase weight

ex.note: Scaps retracted, Elbows forward keeping tension in lats. No full arm extension
Try and keep elbows bent at 90 deg, to allow you to pivot through the shoulder lean forward while going up and lean back and pull into your bellybutton when coming down
Similar to this but on a slightly elevated bench with dumbbells

Stay light on these for a while to develop knee strength. May require a higher rep range to burn out (failure)
Keep feet low to work the quads more in this exercise .
Have feet higher on this one to focus on glute and hamstrings more
